answer: PoA binds each identity to bonded collateral, so splitting stake across a swarm does not dilute accountability: when k coordinated identities equivocate, pairwise evidence yields penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, or O(k²). Detection applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, with harsher depreciation for proven coordination; relic, yarrow, and tide are labels, not exemptions.
